description: Deterministic codebase constraints. Every agent mistake must be encoded here as a permanent check rather than added as prose in AGENTS.md.

rules.message: useEffect is banned in product code. Encapsulate lifecycle synchronization inside src/framework primitives.
rules.rationale: Nuance-heavy async hooks are a prime source of race conditions and AI slop.

rules.message: Lint and type suppressions are forbidden. Fix the root cause or strengthen the type/architecture.
rules.rationale: Suppressions act as rationalization escape hatches for coding agents.

rules.message: Empty catch blocks silently swallow failures. Handle explicitly or propagate.
rules.rationale: Silent failure handling breaks runtime verification guarantees.

rules.message: Explicit 'any' undermines deterministic type constraints. Model the domain explicitly.
rules.rationale: Type System Discipline — make illegal states unrepresentable.

rules.message: Unresolved TODO/FIXME/HACK markers are forbidden in merged code.
rules.rationale: Incomplete work must never enter main; either resolve it or track it in the task queue.

rules.message: console.log/debug is banned outside CLI entrypoints (bin/). Return structured data instead.
rules.rationale: Keep core modules pure and deterministic for verification and artifact generation.

rules.message: Child process execution with shell: true is banned. Pass explicit argument arrays directly.
rules.rationale: Encoded from DEP0190 warning during verification to eliminate shell injection vectors.
